WITH claves AS (
    SELECT
        n.orden::integer AS orden,
        n.clave
    FROM unnest(ARRAY[{NPs}]::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS n(clave, orden)
),
productos AS (
    SELECT
        c.orden,
        c.clave AS clave_solicitada,
        pp.id AS product_id,
        pp.default_code AS clave,
        pt.id AS product_tmpl_id,
        pt.name AS descripcion,
        uom.name AS unidad,
        NULLIF(pt.material_type, '') AS empaque_producto,
        pt.udv AS udv_producto
    FROM claves c
    LEFT JOIN product_product pp
        ON pp.default_code = c.clave
       AND pp.default_code IN ({NPs})
    LEFT JOIN product_template pt
        ON pt.id = pp.product_tmpl_id
    LEFT JOIN product_uom uom
        ON uom.id = pt.uom_id
),
empaques_catalogo AS (
    SELECT
        ppack.product_tmpl_id,
        string_agg(
            concat_ws(
                ' ',
                NULLIF(ppack.name, ''),
                CASE
                    WHEN ppack.qty IS NOT NULL
                        THEN 'x ' || trim(to_char(ppack.qty, 'FM999999990.########'))
                END
            ),
            ', ' ORDER BY ppack.sequence, ppack.name
        ) AS empaque_catalogo
    FROM product_packaging ppack
    GROUP BY
        ppack.product_tmpl_id
),
almacenes AS (
    SELECT
        sw.id AS warehouse_id,
        sw.code AS almacen_codigo,
        sw.name AS almacen_nombre,
        sl.parent_left,
        sl.parent_right
    FROM stock_warehouse sw
    JOIN stock_location sl
        ON sl.id = sw.lot_stock_id
),
existencias AS (
    SELECT
        sq.product_id,
        COALESCE(a.almacen_codigo, a.almacen_nombre, split_part(sl.complete_name, '/', 1), sl.name) AS almacen,
        sl.complete_name AS ubicacion,
        COALESCE(qpack.name, pack.name) AS empaque_existencia,
        sum(sq.qty) AS cantidad,
        sum(COALESCE(sq.udv_total, 0)) AS udv_total,
        sum(COALESCE(sq.ua_total, 0)) AS ua_total
    FROM stock_quant sq
    JOIN stock_location sl
        ON sl.id = sq.location_id
    LEFT JOIN almacenes a
        ON sl.parent_left >= a.parent_left
       AND sl.parent_right <= a.parent_right
    LEFT JOIN product_packaging qpack
        ON qpack.id = sq.packaging_type_id
    LEFT JOIN stock_quant_package sqpack
        ON sqpack.id = sq.package_id
    LEFT JOIN product_packaging pack
        ON pack.id = sqpack.packaging_id
    WHERE sl.usage = 'internal'
    GROUP BY
        sq.product_id,
        COALESCE(a.almacen_codigo, a.almacen_nombre, split_part(sl.complete_name, '/', 1), sl.name),
        sl.complete_name,
        COALESCE(qpack.name, pack.name)
    HAVING sum(sq.qty) <> 0
)
SELECT
    p.orden,
    p.clave_solicitada,
    CASE
        WHEN p.product_id IS NULL THEN 'NO ENCONTRADO'
        WHEN e.product_id IS NULL THEN 'SIN EXISTENCIA INTERNA'
        ELSE 'OK'
    END AS estado,
    p.clave,
    p.descripcion,
    p.unidad,
    COALESCE(p.empaque_producto, e.empaque_existencia, ec.empaque_catalogo, '') AS empaque,
    p.udv_producto,
    e.almacen,
    e.ubicacion,
    e.cantidad,
    e.udv_total,
    e.ua_total,
    ''::text AS contado_por
FROM productos p
LEFT JOIN empaques_catalogo ec
    ON ec.product_tmpl_id = p.product_tmpl_id
LEFT JOIN existencias e
    ON e.product_id = p.product_id
ORDER BY
    p.orden,
    e.almacen NULLS LAST,
    e.ubicacion NULLS LAST,
    empaque NULLS LAST;
query_existencias:
WITH ubicaciones_objetivo AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (VALUES
        (1, 'Physical Locations/AMP/Stock/B&A'),
        (2, 'Physical Locations/AMP/Stock/EPTs'),
        (3, 'Physical Locations/AMP/Stock/Insumos'),
        (4, 'Physical Locations/AMP/Stock/Prop. Cte.')
    ) AS u(orden, almacen)
),
objetivos_normalizados AS (
    SELECT
        orden,
        almacen,
        regexp_replace(almacen, '[[:space:]]*/[[:space:]]*', '/', 'g') AS almacen_normalizado
    FROM ubicaciones_objetivo
),
quants_actuales AS (
    SELECT
        sq.product_id,
        sq.qty,
        loc.complete_name AS ubicacion_completa,
        regexp_replace(loc.complete_name, '[[:space:]]*/[[:space:]]*', '/', 'g') AS ubicacion_normalizada
    FROM stock_quant sq
    JOIN stock_location loc
        ON loc.id = sq.location_id
    WHERE loc.usage = 'internal'
      AND sq.qty <> 0
),
ubicaciones_filtradas AS (
    SELECT
        qa.product_id,
        qa.qty,
        obj.orden AS almacen_orden,
        obj.almacen,
        qa.ubicacion_completa
    FROM quants_actuales qa
    JOIN objetivos_normalizados obj
        ON qa.ubicacion_normalizada = obj.almacen_normalizado
        OR qa.ubicacion_normalizada ILIKE obj.almacen_normalizado || '/%'
),
producto_ubicacion AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        almacen_orden,
        almacen,
        ubicacion_completa,
        sum(qty) AS cantidad_stock_ubicacion
    FROM ubicaciones_filtradas
    GROUP BY
        product_id,
        almacen_orden,
        almacen,
        ubicacion_completa
    HAVING sum(qty) <> 0
),
almacenes_por_producto AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        array_agg(almacen ORDER BY almacen_orden, almacen) AS almacenes
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            product_id,
            almacen_orden,
            almacen
        FROM producto_ubicacion
    ) a
    GROUP BY
        product_id
)
SELECT
    pp.default_code AS "Materia Prima",
    pt.name AS "Descripción",
    uom.name AS "Unidad",
    NULLIF(pt.material_type, '') AS "Empaque",
    app.almacenes AS "Almacén",
    array_agg(pu.ubicacion_completa ORDER BY pu.almacen_orden, pu.ubicacion_completa) AS "Ubicación Completa",
    sum(pu.cantidad_stock_ubicacion) AS "Cantidad Stock",
    ''::text AS "Contado Por"
FROM producto_ubicacion pu
JOIN product_product pp
    ON pp.id = pu.product_id
JOIN product_template pt
    ON pt.id = pp.product_tmpl_id
LEFT JOIN product_uom uom
    ON uom.id = pt.uom_id
LEFT JOIN almacenes_por_producto app
    ON app.product_id = pu.product_id
GROUP BY
    pp.default_code,
    pt.name,
    uom.name,
    NULLIF(pt.material_type, ''),
    app.almacenes
ORDER BY
    min(pu.almacen_orden),
    pp.default_code;
query_pool:
WITH nps AS (
    SELECT
        x.orden::integer AS orden,
        x.default_code
    FROM unnest(ARRAY[
        {NPs}
    ]::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS x(default_code, orden)
),
productos AS (
    SELECT
        n.orden,
        n.default_code AS default_code_solicitado,
        pp.id AS product_id,
        pp.default_code
    FROM nps n
    LEFT JOIN product_product pp
        ON upper(pp.default_code) = upper(n.default_code)
),
recepciones_compra AS (
    SELECT
        p.orden,
        p.default_code_solicitado,
        p.default_code,
        po.id AS purchase_order_id,
        loc_dest.complete_name AS ubicacion_completa,
        dense_rank() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.default_code_solicitado
            ORDER BY
                COALESCE(po.date_approve, po.date_order, po.create_date) DESC NULLS LAST,
                po.id DESC
        ) AS rank_ultima_oc
    FROM productos p
    JOIN purchase_order_line pol
        ON pol.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN purchase_order po
        ON po.id = pol.order_id
       AND po.state <> 'cancel'
    JOIN stock_move sm
        ON sm.purchase_line_id = pol.id
       AND sm.product_id = p.product_id
       AND sm.state = 'done'
    JOIN stock_picking sp
        ON sp.id = sm.picking_id
       AND sp.state = 'done'
    JOIN stock_picking_type spt
        ON spt.id = sp.picking_type_id
       AND spt.code = 'incoming'
    JOIN stock_location loc_dest
        ON loc_dest.id = sm.location_dest_id
)
SELECT
    p.default_code_solicitado AS "Default Code",
    string_agg(DISTINCT r.ubicacion_completa, ', ' ORDER BY r.ubicacion_completa) AS "Nombre Completo Ubicacion"
FROM productos p
LEFT JOIN recepciones_compra r
    ON r.default_code_solicitado = p.default_code_solicitado
   AND r.rank_ultima_oc = 1
GROUP BY
    p.orden,
    p.default_code_solicitado
ORDER BY
    p.orden;
query_epts:
with general_ as (
select
                            inv.default_code,
                            max(inv.product_name) product_name,
                            inv.material_type,
                            inv.code,
                            max(inv.id_location) id_location,
                            max(inv.location_full) location_full,
                            max(inv.location_key) location_key,
                            sum(inv.qty) qty,
                            sum(inv.costo) costo,
                            sum(inv.liters) liters,
                            max(inv.uom) uom,
                            lote
                        from
                            (
                            select
                                pt.default_code as default_code,
                                pt.name as product_name,
                                case
                                    when substring(pt.default_code,1,3) = 'EPT' then
                                        'EPT'
                                    when pt.material_type isnull then
                                        'NO DEFINIDO'
                                    else
                                        pt.material_type
                                end material_type,
                                aa.code,
                                sl.id id_location,
                                sl.complete_name location_full,
                                sliden.name as location_key,
                                qty as qty,
                                costo,
                                to_char(liters, 'FM999999990.00') :: float as liters,
                                uom.name as uom,
                                sq.lote
                            from
                                (
                                select
                                    SUM(sq.qty) as qty,
                                    SUM(sq.qty * sq.cost) costo,
                                    SUM(sq.udv_total) as liters,
                                    sq.product_id,
                                    sq.location_id,
                                    spl.name as lote
                                from
                                    stock_quant sq
                                left join stock_production_lot spl on sq.lot_id = spl.id
                                group by
                                    sq.location_id,
                                    sq.product_id,
                                    spl.name
                                order by
                                    location_id asc,
                                    product_id asc) as sq
                            inner join
                             stock_location sl
                             on
                                sl.id = sq.location_id
                            left join account_account aa on
                                sl.valuation_in_account_id = aa.id
                            inner join
                             product_product pp
                             on
                                sq.product_id = pp.id
                            inner join
                             product_template pt
                             on
                                pp.product_tmpl_id = pt.id
                            inner join
                             product_uom uom
                             on
                                pt.uom_id = uom.id
                            left join
                             stock_location sliden
                             on
                                sliden.id = sl.location_id
                        )inv
                        where
                            inv.location_key not in('Virtual Locations', 'Partner Locations', 'INDIR', 'MKT')
                            and inv.id_location  in (172,1230,1039,1231)
                        group by
                            inv.material_type, inv.code, inv.default_code, lote)
               select * from general_  where default_code like any( array['EPT%', 'MES%'])     
              ;

cedis1_odoo.query:
select
        stock.almacen,
        c4.name familia,
        pt.udv as udv,
        pt.default_code clave,
        pt.name descripcion,
        pu.name udm,
        package_type presentacion,
        basico.x_name tipo_basico,
        xs.x_name clas_servicio,
        to_char(stock.inventario,
        'FM999999990.00') :: float existencia,
        to_char(pt.udv * stock.inventario,
        'FM999999990.00') :: float litros,
        pp.id,
        pt.platform_pieces as piezas_x_tarima
    from
        product_product pp
    inner join
    (
        select
            product_id as pid,
            sum(qty) as inventario,
            sl.complete_name as almacen
        from
            stock_quant
        inner join stock_location sl on
            sl.id = stock_quant.location_id
        where
            (sl.complete_name like '%/APT/Stock%'
                or sl.complete_name like '%/APT/Existencias%')
        group by
            product_id,
            sl.complete_name 
            )        
            stock on
        stock.pid = pp.id
    left join product_template pt on
        pp.product_tmpl_id = pt.id
    left join product_uom pu on
        pt.uom_id = pu.id
    left join product_category c1 on
        pt.categ_id = c1.id
    left join product_category c2 on
        c1.parent_id = c2.id
    left join product_category c3 on
        c2.parent_id = c3.id
    left join product_category c4 on
        c3.parent_id = c4.id
    left join x_tipo_material basico on
        pt.x_nivel_calidad = basico.id
    left join x_servicio xs on
        pt.x_servicio = xs.id
where almacen ='Physical Locations/APT/Stock/Cedis I'
    order by
        familia,
        udm,
        existencia;

-- Productos con lote y existencia actual en ubicaciones AMP.
WITH ubicaciones_objetivo AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (VALUES
        (1, 'Physical Locations/AMP/Stock/B&A'),
        (2, 'Physical Locations/AMP/Stock/EPTs'),
        (3, 'Physical Locations/AMP/Stock/Insumos'),
        (4, 'Physical Locations/AMP/Stock/Prop. Cte.')
    ) AS u(orden, almacen)
),
objetivos_normalizados AS (
    SELECT
        orden,
        almacen,
        regexp_replace(almacen, '[[:space:]]*/[[:space:]]*', '/', 'g') AS almacen_normalizado
    FROM ubicaciones_objetivo
),
existencia_lote_actual AS (
    SELECT
        obj.orden AS almacen_orden,
        pp.default_code AS np,
        loc.complete_name AS ubicacion,
        lot.name AS lote,
        sum(sq.qty) AS cantidad_actual
    FROM stock_quant sq
    JOIN stock_location loc
        ON loc.id = sq.location_id
    JOIN objetivos_normalizados obj
        ON regexp_replace(loc.complete_name, '[[:space:]]*/[[:space:]]*', '/', 'g') = obj.almacen_normalizado
        OR regexp_replace(loc.complete_name, '[[:space:]]*/[[:space:]]*', '/', 'g') ILIKE obj.almacen_normalizado || '/%'
    JOIN product_product pp
        ON pp.id = sq.product_id
    JOIN stock_production_lot lot
        ON lot.id = sq.lot_id
       AND lot.product_id = sq.product_id
    WHERE loc.usage = 'internal'
      AND sq.lot_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        obj.orden,
        pp.default_code,
        loc.complete_name,
        lot.name
    HAVING sum(sq.qty) > 0
)
SELECT
    np AS "NP",
    ubicacion AS "UBICACION",
    lote AS "LOTE",
    cantidad_actual AS "CANTIDAD"
FROM existencia_lote_actual
ORDER BY
    almacen_orden,
    ubicacion,
    np,
    lote;
